Nice family food restaurant!
Dec 2022
This was our revisit after our last visit in 2019 (before Covid19) and that left us great impression and so decided to revisit again.

The restaurant is located in De Tham street, where many family restaurants are located. If you are a first time visitor, you maybe spoiled for choice which restaurant to visit as all look "good"!

For us, without hesitation, we went to this restaurant. And surprisingly it was quite empty although it was 7.30pm in the evening. Only 2 tables were occupied (on 2nd storey, including ours). Think Covid19 has hit hard on the small and medium businesses here.

We ordered the pork ribs with fried rice, BBQ clams, stir fried cauliflowers and water spinach and deep fried chicken. We didn't order the BBQ oysters and beef dishes as we just had them the night before and wanted something "light".

Portions were huge, And the food were yummy, well marinated and cooked to perfection, consistently good no doubt in that! And prices were reasonable too, despite of inflation, the price did not rise or rise slightly like 5000 dong only.

Our dinner at around 220,000 dong. We didn't order any drink as we had plan to visit a cafe for iced beverages as the weather was warm. And it took us 10mins via Grab to get back to Saigon Center for our drinks then!

Very Delicious and Cheap Seafood!
Sep 2019
The restaurant is located about 10mins drive from ben thanh market in district 1. It is a family run "home cooking style" restaurant, in a 3-storey shophouse.

On the day of our visit, it was raining quite heavily and the time was around 7.15pm when we arrived. One of the "staff" attended to our Grab car and opened the door for us and sheltered us with umbrella into the building, as what hotels will do! Cool! (it was later that we realized this lady is the person-in-charge of the restaurant who spoke very good English and she also sheltered us back to the Grab car upon leaving).

We sat at the 2nd storey as there was an empty table (the 3rd storey, had a steep flight of steps up would be very challenging for my 80+ years old mum but the washroom was located here!).

The restaurant had a simple, normal setup, nothing fantasy or great but you could feel the "ground to earth, simple locals' lifestyle" atmosphere. The restaurant was quite crowded as we saw many diners going up/coming down from the 3rd storey during our dinning there.

After browsing through the menu, we ordered a seafood soup, seafood fried crispy noodles, white clams soup, grilled scallops and grilled octopus. Perhaps due to the large dinning crowd or took longer time to prepare the grilled items, the food did not all come at the same or about the same time. The grilled items were the last to be served, about a good 15mins later than the others but that was no problem for us.

Verdict on food? Well, they were super nice and delicious. Not only the seafood items were fresh, perfectly cooked and in generous portions. Each item came with a specific sauce to go along well. Every dish we ordered was very good and we enjoyed the food so much, one of the top few best we have tried!

The staff were all very friendly and helpful. There's free wifi here and you can ask the staff to key in the password for you. During our dinning, the 2 young children (elder sister and brother) of the owner were around and playing with each other but we somehow managed to communicate with them, they were very cute.

It was a great value for money dinning here and if I didn't remember wrongly, the bill cost about S$21 in total. It was reasonably cheap and with such nice and yummy food, it's super worth it and would highly recommend this place. You are paying for hotel level (or even better) food and yet at normal coffee shop prices!

We will surely revisit this restaurant again as we visit HCMC at least once a year but this was our 1st time visit here despite coming to HCMC for so many times already! (you can check out my video at this restaurant in my Facebook or IG as I am not able to share the video here)

The portions of the snails were small, but I liked that they were the larger type of snail (not those tiny ones). We also had the snails prepared another way, but I preferred the addictive fat fried ones. 

We were quoted 600,000 vnd for 1 kg for the crab, but it ended up being 560,000 since we got a smaller crab. Note to self, order a bigger crab next time. 

Their morning glory in garlic was yummy too and a good dish to accompany the seafood. 

The grilled scallops were fine, but a bit on the smaller side. 

There was one sweet lady (not sure if she was the owner), who told us to be careful with our belongings and cellphones when we were in hcmc, especially district 1.
